endless.line: And some kinds of love, the possibilities are endless
stanza: Some kinds of love, Marguerita told Tom
Like a dirty French novel combines the absurd with the vulgar
And some kinds of love, the possibilities are endless
And for me to miss one would seem to be groundless

endless.line: Another chapter in a book where the chapters are endless
stanza: With all the pathos and pain
Another chapter in a book where the chapters are endless
A verse, then a verse, and refrain
